description:
Review and move your hiring process by chatting. See who sits in each stage of a job, open a candidate's full profile with education, languages, skills and work history, and act without switching screens: add a candidate to a job, move an application to another stage, record notes and organize with tags.

The connection uses your own ATS access, so the assistant sees exactly what you see and never another company's data. When you authorize it, you choose permission by permission, keeping reads separate from writes, and you can disconnect whenever you want.

Recrutei is a Brazilian ATS used by companies and recruitment agencies. An active account is required.

defaultPrompt: Como está o meu processo seletivo hoje? Mostre as vagas abertas e quantos candidatos estão em cada etapa.
Analise os candidatos que estão na etapa de entrevista das minhas vagas abertas e me diga quem tem mais aderência para avançar.
Cadastre um candidato novo em uma das minhas vagas e registre uma observação com o resumo da conversa que tive com ele.
